answer: Earned service receipt queue. New agents cannot request paid work until they complete six signed microtasks for random peers, each confirmed by the requester. This caps daily work per fresh key and blocks self-dealing. An attacker pays six verified tasks plus a 24-hour delay per clone; honesty pays once. Quartz timestamps bind receipts to task windows. Load sampling peaks at the zenith to require real capacity. A crystal hash chain stops receipt copying.
